title: pteridium aquilinum subsp. capense
intro: Pteridium aquilinum subsp. capense, commonly known as the South African bracken fern, is a subspecies of the bracken fern plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the fern family. It is native to the southern regions of Africa. The South African bracken fern has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
